en: Black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a broad river in the foreground with trees and bushes along its banks. Across the river lie open fields and a cluster of buildings, including a prominent light‑colored institutional building, likely a school, with forested hills in the distant background. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left and a photographer's signature at the bottom right.
